name: Basel-Landschaft
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Basel-Landschaft
summary: A white square with a red crozier facing the fly, with seven knobs along its curve. It was adopted after the canton separated from the city of Basel in 1833.
origin: After the rural districts broke away from the city of Basel in 1833, the new canton reversed the city's crozier and coloured it red.

symbols.name: Red crozier
symbols.description: A crozier with seven red knobs, facing the fly.
symbols.meaning: The seven districts that first formed the canton, by tradition.

facts: Its crozier faces the opposite way from Basel-Stadt's.
clues: A red bishop's staff with knobs on white.
It broke away from a city in 1833.
